comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 3
Consumed Gauge: 90
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 75

It requires two/three seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech needs only one second till it activates.

Effect:
Aside from damage, your target(s) get "Deadly Poison" status and loses 25 ~ 50 stamina per second. This effect last for at least 20 seconds. Higher Trap prolongs the "Deadly Poison" -effect.

I've learned this from "Brunei banditlv38" outside the gate of Brunei after he used this Tech against me.
